python -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
df.columns = ['Category', 'Item', 'Amount']
df['Amount'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Amount'], errors='coerce')

# Expenses rows: rows 9-21 (0-indexed 9..21) = Excel rows 10-22
exp = df.iloc[9:22].copy()
print('Per-category totals:')
print(exp.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum().to_string())
print()
print('Grand total expenses: $', exp['Amount'].sum())
